title: Plan a Trip to Carson City's Antique Mall | Routes & Hours
description: Driving to Northern Nevada's largest antique mall? Routes and drive times from Reno, Lake Tahoe and Carson Valley, plus hours, parking and what to bring.

hero.h1: Plan a trip to Northern Nevada's largest antique mall
hero.lede: We're at 1831 N Carson St in Carson City, open every day from 10 to 6. Here's how to get here from Reno, the lake and the Valley — and what to know before you go.

photo.alt: The mall's front window vinyl reads: The Largest Antique Mall in Northern Nevada
photo.caption: The window says it. Over 21,000 square feet, on two floors.

close.h2: See you on North Carson Street, under the yellow sign
close.body: 1831 N Carson St, Carson City, NV 89701 — about a mile north of the State Capitol, with a parking lot right out front. The cashier's at the entrance; the booths go on from there.
